sentences.japanese: 飛行機が乱気流に近付いていたため操縦士は乗客にシートベルトを締めるよう呼びかけた。
sentences.english: As the plane was approaching turbulence, the pilot asked the passengers aboard the plane to fasten their seat belts.

sentences.japanese: 金融引き締め政策が実施されている。
sentences.english: A fiscal tightening policy is being enacted.

sentences.japanese: 金融引き締めで金利が上昇するだろう。
sentences.english: Interest rates will rise due to monetary tightening.

sentences.japanese: 基地の中でも外でも、シートベルトを締めなさい。
sentences.english: On base and off, buckle your seat-belts.

sentences.japanese: 我々は玄関が締まっているのが分かった。
sentences.english: We found the front door locked.
